'''Hammerbeak''' was a large [[Mantellian flutterplume/Legends|Mantellian flutterplume]] that lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] during the [[Alderaan Civil War]]. It frequently hunted in the stretch of the [[Fornaak River]] that was located east of [[House Baliss (estate)|House Baliss]], between the [[Alsakan Lowlands]] and [[King's Pass]]. Hammerbeak was killed during the last years of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].<ref name="Enemy" />
